arg.name: use_sim_time
arg.description: Use the /clock topic for time to sync with simulation

arg.name: nav_graph_path
arg.description: Path to the navigation graph YAML file (e.g., 0.yaml)

arg.name: match_tolerance
arg.description: Tolerance (meters) for matching mutex entry/exit coordinates to itinerary waypoints

arg.name: claim_distance
arg.description: Distance (meters) from mutex entry to trigger claim logic

arg.name: exit_reached_distance
arg.description: Distance (meters) to mutex exit to detect exit reached

arg.name: clearance_distance
arg.description: Distance (meters) beyond mutex exit to ensure full clearance before releasing
